args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since deploying v2.3.1 to production (all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks (error rate 0.18). Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to v2.3.0 in all production regions. Verified the service is now healthy (error rate 0.002) on v2.3.0 across all regions.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.
